score_objections.objection: None of the checked sources addresses regulating Big Tech or platforms. The only regulation-adjacent evidence is his data-center stance: he explicitly says Congress will not create a regulatory environment and backs only an information/disclosure bill, and his cyber hearing statement asks for DHS defenses and public-private partnership, not rules on AI firms. That is at best mixed-to-light-touch on regulation, and it is not about tech regulation in the Big Tech sense. Evidence for -1 'Targeted rules' is too thin; either drop the score or set it to Mixed if the disclosure bill is counted.
